items.text: sahi item nahi aaya
damage ho gaya
order galat hai

items.context: Kya aapne product check kar liya hai?
items.text: haan bilkul

items.context: Kya aapko order number mil gaya hai?
items.text: order track karna hai

items.context: Aap chahte hain ki hum aapko refund dein?
items.text: refund chahiye
mera package deliver hua lekin item totally alag hai
maine order kiya tha shirt par mujhe pant mila hai
jo item bheja tha wo pura damaged tha box kholte hi pata chal gaya
kya aap mujhe replacement bhej sakte hain jaldi se
main ne kal order kiya tha aur abhi product galat aaya hai
kya aap refund process karenge ya naya item bhejenge
mera order number 456789 hai aur main kuch solution chah raha hoon

items.context: Kya aapne order receive kiya hai?
items.text: haan maine delivery receive kar li hai par product galat hai

items.context: Kya aap bata sakte hain ki kya galat item mila hai?
items.text: shirt ki jagah mujhe trousers mila hai bilkul alag hai

items.context: Kya product par damage dikh raha hai?
items.text: product damage hai box khulte hi kapde phate hue dikh rahe the
main chahta hoon ki aap mere liye replacement bhejdein

items.context: Kya aap exchange karwana chahte hain?
items.text: kya main ye product exchange kar sakta hoon kisi store mein
maine apne order mein ek mobile cover mangwaya tha lekin mujhe galat color ka cover mila hai abhi tak pakka nahin hai ki kaise solve karenge
product kholne par pata chala ki jo bhi aaya hai wo pura kharab aur defective hai mujhe iska jaldi replacement chahiye
delay hone ke baad jo item mujhe mila wo brand new nahi tha aur usme scratches aur damage hua hua tha ab main kya kar sakta hoon

items.context: Hum aapki complaint sun ke bahut maafi chahte hain aapko kya chahiye replacement ya refund?
items.text: aapke help ke liye dhanyavaad lekin mujhe refund ya replacement dono mein se ek jaldi dena hai

items.context: Kya aapko lagta hai ki humari team se galti hui hai?
items.text: main yeh batana chahata hoon ki order sahi tha meri taraf se koi dikkat nahi thi lekin delivery mein galat saman dena thoda bura laga

items.context: Kya aap product ke sath hi replacement chahenge ya nayi order place karna chahenge?
items.text: abhi bhi product mere paas hai aur main expect karta hoon ki aap log is issue ko jaldi resolve karke mujhe proper product bhejenge

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: delivery
Intent: wrong_or_damaged - received a wrong or damaged item
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: plain and direct

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
